WELCOME TO
We treat the root cause, not just the symptoms.
Call Us Today
Consultation Request
Redefining What Primary Pet Care Looks Like
Designed for Root-Cause Healing
At Prism Integrative Veterinary Health, we combine advanced diagnostics with clinically proven holistic therapies to uncover why your pet is unwell, and partner with you to create real, lasting change.
We’re not here to suppress symptoms, we’re here to solve them. Our approach blends the best of conventional veterinary medicine with evidence-based natural healing to create a truly integrative model of care.
We use cutting-edge diagnostics to identify the root causes of chronic issues, empowering you with more information, more options, and more control. If you’ve ever walked away from a vet visit still wondering why your pet isn’t getting better, you’re exactly who we’re here for.
Because healing isn’t just about what we do in the clinic: it’s about transforming the way you care for your pet, for good.
Innovation
Ambassadorship
Hope
Empowerment
Balance
Our Mission
To redefine what “primary care” means by delivering integrative veterinary medicine that prioritizes prevention, partnership, and personalized healing.
We believe:
You deserve clear answers to the questions other vets brush off.
Your pet’s care should go beyond managing symptoms : it should uncover root causes.
Wellness isn’t a one-size-fits-all plan. It’s a journey we take together.We’re not here to sell Band-Aids.
We’re here to shift the model, so you and your pet have the tools, guidance, and support to live vibrantly, naturally, and in true health.
Request a Consultation
Our Philosophies
We believe that true wellness begins by asking deeper questions, not just what is wrong, but why. Our integrative approach blends advanced diagnostics with clinically proven natural therapies and conventional medicine to uncover root causes, not just manage symptoms.
This philosophy of proactive, whole-patient care is the foundation of everything we do. It’s a model originally shaped by integrative veterinary oncologist, Dr. Kendra Pope, and now embodied by our entire team: each of our doctors is deeply trained in the same values, protocols, and commitment to personalized, long-term healing.
We view your pet as a whole being, influenced by lifestyle, environment, and emotional wellness: and we see you, the pet parent, as a vital part of their care team. Whether you’re coming in for your first visit or continuing a wellness journey with us, you can feel confident knowing every decision is guided by the same integrative principles: partnership, purpose, and healing that lasts.

Award‑Winning Veterinary Care in Tinton Falls
Prism Integrative Veterinary Health was ranked the #1 veterinarian in Tinton Falls by BusinessRate in December 2025, based on real Google review performance and reputation metrics. This independent recognition reflects years of consistent, high‑quality care, strong client feedback, and a commitment to helping pets feel better and live longer. When you choose Prism, you’re choosing a team that pet parents in your community already trust and recommend.

Our Goal IS TO Help Your Pet Live Longer
REVIEWS & TESTIMONIALS
We recently moved from California to Monmouth County and needed to find a holistic vet for our miniature dachshund Ollie to continue with acupuncture treatment for his back once we moved. We made an appointment with Dr. Brown at Prism in the fall and quickly realized that prism is more than a holistic veterinary practice.In a few months that we’ve been going to prism Dr. Brown has helped Ollie with a skin infection and also redirected Ollie’s diet so that he can continue to live a healthy active life. The care we receive is world class. Dr. Brown is incredibly knowledgeable and passionate about being a vet. The support staff is welcoming and also very passionate and knowledgeable. We are so happy we found prism.
- Bob Gambino -
One of the best practices I’ve been to. I started bringing my dog, Tilly here after a potential cancer scare - it was benign but our other vet told us it was “inflammation.” Not knowing more than that, I wanted more answers and a way to prevent cancer moving forward. Dr. Marino has been working with us on diet changes, inflammation testing, and supplements to help keep her as healthy as she can be. Tilly is my soul dog, and they’ve done everything to settle my crazy dog mom nerves. I would recommend them to anybody that wants a practice they can trust!
- Jenna Pagnotta -
My cat, Gus, has been going to Prism for around 2 years now. Dr. Marino has demonstrated so much patience and kindness. She is always willing to answer questions. She never makes us feel rushed. We also recently started seeing Dr. Brown for Chriopractic care and she is incredible as well. I have seen so much improvement in Gus’ quality of life since working with Dr. Marino and Dr. Brown. All of the vet techs are also wonderful and offer such gentle love and patience  to Gus who is scared of his own shadow.
- Kelsie Teehan -
Our girl Daisy has only been a patient of Prism and Dr. Brown since early December, just about 1 1/2 months. We’ve been very happy with the care given by everyone here. We are hopeful that working them and following an integrative approach will give Daisy back her good health. She loves it there (as much as a dog can love going to the doctor) and is very calm with Dr. Brown’s energy, unlike our experiences in other vet offices. Looking for a practice that really cares about your animal and their health, not just prescribing a bunch of meds? This is the place. Highly recommend
- April Barry -
Wonderful! Doctors, staff, and atmosphere are wonderful. Your visit is so individualized and the doctor takes time to go over everything throughly. Dr Marino is absolutely amazing. My girl Nala was just recently diagnosed with Mast Cell Cancer. We have treatment plans in place and now following through. I Highly recommend.
- Cara Bartiromo-
I cannot say enough amazing things about Dr. Kendra Pope and her entire team. From the very first visit, it was clear that they don’t just treat—they truly educate. Every appointment feels like a learning experience, and that alone set them apart.
My poor dog Oakley had been struggling with severe colitis, and despite multiple visits, his traditional vet was somehow making things worse. I felt helpless and defeated. Dr. Pope took the time to look deeper and explained how critical the microbiome is to overall health. Instead of more medications, she identified that Oakley needed a specific probiotic and a complete dietary change...
READ MORE...
- Cassie O'Neill -
My dog Carmine has been seeing Dr. Pope for almost a year now, and I truly can’t say enough wonderful things about her. I honestly wish she could be my doctor! She is incredibly compassionate, takes the time to listen to every concern, and always has a thoughtful plan of action. Carmine is almost 14 years old but still looks like a puppy, he’s full of life and energy, and thanks to Dr. Pope, he is truly thriving.I’m beyond grateful for this practice. I drive almost two hours from Westchester, New York just to bring Carmine here because they are that exceptional. Chelsea at the front desk is always so warm and welcoming, and Kate, the vet tech, is incredibly gentle and kind with my sweet boy. The entire team is amazing, I truly love everyone there!
- Christina C -
The staff at Prism are extremely patient, knowledgable, and caring. They always take their time explaining things to us. Our dog has had chronic GI issues and Prism has given us hope with their holistic approaches. Very thankful to the Prism team!
- Ellie Alter-
My dog Lacey has been under the care of Dr. Marino for the last 6 months, since she was diagnosed with cancer. Working in conjunction with conventional treatment, Dr. Marino helped with nutrition and strengthening Lacey's immunities. The advice and help I've been given has been truly amazing. I would definitely recommend Prism Integrative Veterinary Health.
- Lisa Kulick-
